heading.title: Of Discharge from Liability on Notes, Bills and Cheques

article.title: Extinguishment of rights of action on bill in acceptor's hands.
article.content:
90Extinguishment of rights of action on bill in acceptor's hands.

Section 90  ·  Chapter VII  ·  page 21 of the Act
If a bill of exchange which has been negotiated is, at or after maturity, held by the acceptor in his own right, all rights of action thereon are extinguished.
